products.name: Syntyr Pro

An optional localhost-only Go resource edit example is included in the private preview source; it is not a production backend.

products.name: Syntyr Studio
products.description: Private source/preview candidate extending Pro to 30 screen types and 90 static variants, including three original website kits: six B2B SaaS pages, five professional-services pages, and four ecommerce storefront pages. Commerce and checkout are visual examples only; no live cart or payments. Includes the same local-only Go resource reference, not a hosted service.
